protocol.action_permission: accept subset of original V707 accepts; missing evidence and ties escalate
claim_limits: energy/logistic equivalence supplies no extra benefit
protocol.deduplication: keep first identical public head-fit membership vector including empty; never use labels or tune/eval vectors

fit_tune_roles.evaluation: reserved: identity and missing mask only

method_mapping.assumptions_not_transferred: Oracle population residuals, full utility witness optimization, bounded utilities and fresh iid iteration samples do not transfer. Costs are unnormalized and steps are capped at four; no theorem convergence or safety claim.
method_mapping.use: Fixed cost-sensitive witness residuals motivate bounded empirical probability patches.

method_mapping.assumptions_not_transferred: Distribution-level calibrated multiaccuracy and weak agnostic learning assumptions are not established by finite bins, capped updates or exposed dependent delayed data. No global calibration or distribution-free guarantee.
method_mapping.use: Global calibration and local residual controls motivate global-only, local-only and combined comparisons.

patch_rule.residual: sum(g_i*(y_i-p_i))/n_all_training_rows; nonmembers and unavailable evidence contribute zero
patch_rule.selection: largest absolute residual; fixed group order ties

random_control.selection: uniform supported registered group without residual magnitude access; same labels fit delta

utility_residuals.scope: descriptive fixed finite witness class; not full calibration
